The Artorian kingdom rises in power and begins a new wizard order: The Redsong Wizards, using the teachings and remaining books of the old Starshaper and Magusflame orders. This in addition to a treaty with the Dwarves of Bourn Dorhul begins a somewhat prosperous and decent era of Humanity leading up to the current day.
